drhp.business: Merritronix is a B2B ESDM company specializing in high-reliability, mission-critical electronic assemblies and systems for defence, aerospace, telecommunications and specialized industrial electronics. Its integrated offering spans component sourcing, PCB (SMT/THT) assembly, system integration, testing and box-build/finished-product delivery, executed to defence and aerospace quality standards. Revenue is derived from turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print, obsolescence engineering management, trading sales and job work.

business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Vertically integrated EMS execution: sourcing, PCB assembly, system integration, testing and quality control are performed in-house within a unified execution framework, with turnkey/build-to-print delivered end-to-end from component sourcing through system delivery. Mechanical enclosure fabrication and related processes, where required, are outsourced to third-party vendors so customers engage through a single coordinated interface. Components are procured from a network of authorized global suppliers; the trading-sales segment proactively pre-stocks long-lead / supply-constrained parts to mitigate supply-chain risk and reduce lead times. Obsolescence-management capability (component re-sourcing, reverse engineering, Form-Fit-Function replacements, alternate component qualification and system redesign) extends the operational life of legacy platforms.

overview.business_model: Primarily engaged in business-to-business (B2B) electronic manufacturing services, encompassing component sourcing, printed circuit board (PCB) assembly, system integration, testing, box-build solutions and delivery of finished electronic products, executed to the quality standards required by India's strategic defence and aerospace programmes. Revenue is derived from a diversified set of business segments, namely job work, turnkey manufacturing/build-to-print, obsolescence management (including obsolete component procurement and engineering support) and trading sales.

genesis.founding_story: Our Company was incorporated on October 14, 1988 as 'Merritronix Private Limited', a private limited company under the Companies Act, 1956. After an early phase in telecommunications component supply, the Company entered defence and aerospace electronics manufacturing, establishing itself as a vendor to defence public sector undertakings. We subsequently transitioned to turnkey electronics manufacturing, providing end-to-end solutions from component sourcing to system delivery, and more recently developed a dedicated obsolescence management capability enabling customers with legacy electronics lifecycle requirements to extend the operational life of critical platforms without complete system replacement.
